course_summary:
ISEN 622 | Linear Programming | Fall 2026
Instructor: Sergiy Butenko | butenko@tamu.edu
Meets: TR 11:10AM-12:25PM | ZACH 345
Grading: Lecture quizzes [10%], Homework assignments [15%], Three in-class exams [25%], Three in-class exams [25%], Three in-class exams [25%] — A: [90,100], B: [80,90), C: [70,80), D: [60,70), F: [0,60)
Topics: Gomory Cut, Farkas' Lemma, KKT Conditions, The Primal-Dual Simplex Method, Dantzig-Wolfe Decomposition, Two-Stage Stochastic LP, Modeling Either/Or Conditions, Parametric Linear Programming, Complementary slackness, Simplex Method in the Matrix Form, Analysis of the Simplex Method, Simplex Method: Initialization, Simplex Method: Iteration and Termination, Simplex Method: An Introduction, revised simplex method, dual simplex methods, bounded variables, column generation, decomposition, Integer Programming Modeling, integer programming, Representation of Polyhedra, Properties of Polyhedra, polyhedral sets, convex sets, cones, duality theory, sensitivity analysis, LP Modeling, Graphical Method, linear optimization models, small-scale LPs, large-scale LPs, simplex method, linear programming, theory, algorithms, mathematics
Tools: optimization software
Prerequisites: MATH 304
